images.caption: Eastern side of the Captain Charles Horton House, located at 5564 Ferry Street in Vermilion, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1860, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

place.source_title: Captain Charles Horton House eastern side

brief: An island-town cottage lot: Captain Charles Horton House eastern side, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Capt. Charles Horton House (Vermilion), side view: a very steep Gothic Revival gable with a lancet attic window, red-painted trim and bargeboards, tall narrow windows; overgrown evergreens

why.note: Vermilion OH: Lake Erie ship captains' houses of the 1840s-80s (the 'village of lake captains')
